uncertainty_budget.explanation: The Indian market price of the token against the official rupee rate for a dollar. This is the bulk of the gap and it is the part everyone argues about.
No rate was published on the settlement date. Stepping back to 2026-06-25 or forward to 2026-06-29 is undetermined — Rule 206 does not say which.
A daily candle is not a price. It is a range with four printed readings and no rule choosing between them.
The retrieved pair is USDT/INR. The receipt was USDC. The figure is USDT/INR x USDC/USDT, and treating the peg as exactly 1.0000 is a further choice.

regimes.outcome: The receipt is classified as income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset, taxed at 30% under s.115BBH. The value is determined on the date of credit (2026-06-16) using the open market value method. TDS is applicable at 1% as per s.393(1) [Table: Sl. No. 8(vi)]. No penalty applies if the explanation is bona fide and all material facts are disclosed under s.439(8).

citation.provision: Section 115BBH, Income-tax Act, 1961 — carried into the Income-tax Act, 2025

regimes.reasoning: The receipt is classified as income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset under s.115BBH, which taxes such transfers at 30%. The valuation date is the date of credit (2026-06-16) as per Rule 56, Table Sl. No. 1. The valuation method is the open market value as per Rule 57, Table Sl. No. 7, since the asset is not specifically listed in earlier rows. TDS is applicable at 1% as per s.393(1) [Table: Sl. No. 8(vi)] because the payer is a resident and the threshold limit is not exceeded. Under s.439(8), no penalty applies if the explanation is bona fide and all material facts are disclosed.

regimes.consequence_if_failed: If the supply is not an export of services, it will be subject to GST at the applicable rate. The supplier will need to pay the tax and any applicable interest under Section 50 of the CGST Act 2017. If there is a short payment or non-payment of tax, the supplier may also face penalties under Section 74A of the CGST Act 2017.

limits: The specific valuation method for virtual digital assets is not explicitly provided in the rules, leading to reliance on the open market value method as a general fallback.
The place of supply and the relationship between the supplier and recipient are unknown, which affects the determination of the export status.
